metadata.source_format: Kaikki language-specific postprocessed JSONL; this endpoint is deprecated upstream, so preserve the local snapshot

content_screening.policy: Exclude reported/inherently sensitive headwords even when they have neutral senses. Screen every English gloss before definition selection, including whole-word inflections and recognized compounds. Filter killing/murder mentions in any context, weapon mentions, toilet language, demeaning terms, alcohol/tobacco, graphic and sexual content. Other ordinary words may keep suitable independent senses.
content_screening.punjabi: Explicit native/roman headword bans remove paired source records; English vocabulary matching applies to English glosses, never indiscriminately to Roman Punjabi lookup spellings.
content_screening.limitation: Conservative reproducible screening, not exhaustive human editorial review. A filtered sense is not rewritten or restored.

metadata.attribution: Wiktionary contributors; individual source pages and contributor-history links are included with every retained sense. Data extraction by Tatu Ylonen / Wiktextract, distributed by Kaikki.org.
metadata.modifications: Selected Gurmukhi headwords; Unicode NFC and lowercase Roman indexing; excluded nonwords, proper names, reference-only/inflected senses, and sensitive material; grouped by script-specific letter units; selected one original English gloss per word in the single-definition exports.
metadata.filter_source: ../source/family_filter_en.txt and ../build_word_lists.py, with Punjabi headword and source-tag rules in build_punjabi_lists.py
metadata.filter_attribution: Shutterstock, Inc., Copyright 2012-2020; CC BY 4.0; https://github.com/LDNOOBW/List-of-Dirty-Naughty-Obscene-and-Otherwise-Bad-Words. Original filter license: ../source/FILTER_LICENSE.txt.
metadata.normalization: Unicode NFC. Retain original scholarly diacritics; lowercase Roman export keys. No invented transliterations or generated inflections.
definition_selection: Prefer descriptive wording over the English selector's explicit generic definitions or incomplete comma/colon fragments.
Prefer senses without archaic, obsolete, dated, rare, uncommon, dialectal, nonstandard, or historical labels.
Prefer literal senses over senses tagged figuratively.
Then prefer earlier source sense order, source record order, and source sense ID as deterministic tie-breakers.
limitations: English meanings are often brief translations or glosses rather than full explanatory sentences; original wording is preserved.
This source supplies no WordNet-style sense usage counts. Selection uses clarity, source labels, and source order, not a claim of frequency.
Automated family-friendly screening with targeted review, not exhaustive human review or certified child suitability; dialectal and technical vocabulary may remain.
Limited to eligible Gurmukhi headword entries in this source. Shahmukhi-only entries, proper names, compounds with spaces/punctuation, and reference-only/inflected senses are not added.
The two scripts have different lengths; independently grouped lists need not contain the same word sets. Roman homographs are merged with their Gurmukhi spellings and sense-level links preserved.
metadata.length_metric: Latin letters with attached diacritics counted as one unit; keep scholarly diacritics. Digraphs such as kh count as two letters; no spaces/punctuation.
metadata.packaging: Combined length groups; added explicit tile_count and English letter_units; original wording and source sense fields preserved.
